title: The Benchmarking Epistemology: Construct Validity for Evaluating Machine Learning Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze benchmarks related to faith or religion. It discusses the epistemology of benchmarking using case studies in computer vision (ImageNet), meteorology (WeatherBench), and sociology (Fragile Families Challenge).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
